title: Works fast; works great
text: Works fast; works great. I had some quite old popcorn that would not pop very well in the microwave.  I loaded it up in this machine and every kernel popped and it was done in a short time (about 2 to 3 minutes).  Worked great.  I love it.  It will get a lot of use.  The popcorn wasn't so good, but I am sure it was because it was quite old.  Am anxious to try it out with some fresh popcorn.  It is an attractive little machine too.  Doesn't look like it holds much, but it filled up a good size bowl.  I couldn't believe that all the popcorn would be ejected from the spout, but every piece was.  Highly recommended for popcorn fans.  You could make a lot of popcorn in a short time.  In half an hour, you could make about 8 to 10 big bowls of popcorn.

product_metadata.title: Popcorn Maker, 2 Minutes Fast 1200W Popcorn Popper, ETL Certified & BPA Free Air Popper Popcorn Maker, Hot Air Popcorn Popper of 99% Popping Rate with 2 oz (60g) of Kernels, No-Oil Popcorn Machine with Measuring Cup for Home
features: 【Healthy and Fast】: 1200W empowers Acekool popcorn maker to airpop way faster than other brands; with hot air instead of oil, it makes up to 16 cups of oil-free popcorn in 2-3 minutes. Enjoy yummy popcorn without worrying about calories. Plus, it is BPA-free and ETL certified

【99% Popping Rate with 2 oz (60g) of Kernels】: thanks to the hot air swirling technology, Acekool popcorn air popper heats kernels thoroughly and evenly, thus, it pops almost all of the kernels with just a few left unpopped, ONLY add NO more than 2 oz (60g) of kernels once
【One-Button Operation】: one button to start and stop the hot air popper popcorn maker. It will still blow but stop heating when it reaches a certain temperature. Safe and easy

【Upgraded Heat Dissipation】: unlike many other brands whose lids/measuring cups are likely to melt due to overheating, the slotted lid of Acekool air popped popcorn maker is designed for heat dissipating, moreover, there are vent holes at the bottom to help dissipate faster. Thus, the popcorn machine is more durable
【Easy to Clean】: With non-stick coating and oil-free popping, clean-up is a snap. After the mini popcorn maker is completely cooled down, wipe it with a soft cloth and store it for next use
【Portable Design】: the sleek design enables Acekool air popcorn maker to fit nearly anywhere: home movie theater, apartment, office, dormitory, camper, etc. A perfect gift for your family and friends

【NOTE】: ONLY add 2 oz (60g) or less kernels to the chamber to have them all popped; DO NOT add oil or any seasonings into the popcorn maker machine; a 15-minute gap is required for cooling in between each use
